sample_unit: medical sentences and scenarios across languages

links.outcome: Semantic encoding fidelity and output degradation for non-English Indian languages in clinical text
links.effect: EFI degrades by ~90% for all non-English Indian languages tested (p < 10^-13); Kannada shows 1.72-2.05x variance amplification; code-switching and orthographic corruption of medical terms seen in Mistral.
links.quote: Large Language Models show significant systematic degradation of this assumption for non-English languages, producing outputs that are internally consistent but semantically degraded.

unlisted_practices: Measuring encoding fidelity (Encoding Fidelity Index) of tokenizers/embeddings across languages as a pre-deployment check

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating semantic encoding degradation and coherent misalignment in non-English clinical AI across Indian and European languages.
